[list]

[/list]

[color=#6d9eeb][size=5]Compatibilty[/size][/color]

[color=#f4f4f4][size=3]Should be compatible with any mod[/size][size=4].[/size][/color]

[color=#6d9eeb][size=5]Installation[/size][/color]

[list=1]
[*][color=#f4f4f4][size=3]Download all the requirements and the mod (.zip).[/size][/color]
[*][color=#f4f4f4][size=3]Extract the file into the Stardew Valley/mods folder.[/size][/color]
[*][color=#f4f4f4][size=3]Run the game using SMAPI, enjoy![/size][/color]
[/list]

[color=#6d9eeb][size=5]Configuration[/size][/color]

[size=3][b]Glow Rate:[/b][/size][size=3]The player's glow rate while has a vanilla buff whose source is this mod. Larger values makes player more a disco ball while less values slows the glow. If you change the option in game using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url], just wait for the next change of time to apply, then take off the shoe and put it back on.

[b]Numeric Values of Obtaining Methods: [/b]The drop rates and the kill counts can be configurable. I didn't test it if it works immediately if they are changed in the game with GMCM, but probably not. So be aware of that.

[color=#6d9eeb][size=5]Known Issues[/size][/color]

[list]
[*][size=3]Some other colored slimes also can drop the red slime boots. This is planned to be fixed in v2.0[/size]
[/list]
[color=#6d9eeb][size=5]Translations[/size][/color]

[color=#f4f4f4][size=3]Since it is not a big mod, I'd rather all the translation files stay in the original mod. You can contribute to the translations [/size]wherever you prefer.
